--- title: "Model 3 — Neural Net" subtitle: "A small single-hidden-layer MLP via nnet" --- > **Where we are:** Third of six model documents in the > [House Prices — Tidymodels Tour](../index.qmd). Same structure as the others; > we model `log(SalePrice)` and score on RMSE. The neural net is the model that > most needs the recipe's `step_normalize()` + `step_pca()` — MLPs are sensitive > to input scale in a way tree ensembles are not. ## Why a neural net here? A single-hidden-layer MLP learns a smooth nonlinear function of the (normalized, decorrelated) principal components. On a well-featured tabular problem it rarely beats gradient boosting, but it makes *different* errors — which is exactly what makes it a valuable member of the [stacked ensemble](05-stack.qmd) later. ## Setup ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R")) source(here("R", "02_features.R")) library(tidyverse) library(tidymodels) library(here) library(nnet) # the engine ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} train <- readr::read_csv(here("data", "processed", "train.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(SalePrice = log(SalePrice)) ``` ::: ## Recipe, spec, workflow The shared recipe already normalizes all numeric predictors and appends PCs, so the MLP sees well-behaved inputs. We tune the hidden-layer width and the weight decay `penalty`, and lean on `num_comp` to control input dimensionality. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nnet_recipe <- make_recipe(train) nnet_spec <- mlp( hidden_units = tune(), penalty = tune(), epochs = 300 ) |> # MaxNWts must be large enough for (many predictors) x (hidden units); trace # off to keep the tuning log quiet. linout is set automatically in regression. set_engine("nnet", MaxNWts = 10000, trace = FALSE) |> set_mode("regression") nnet_wf <- workflow() |> add_recipe(nnet_recipe) |> add_model(nnet_spec) ``` ::: ## Tuning with 10-fold cross-validation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(42) folds <- vfold_cv(train, v = 10, strata = SalePrice) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} preds <- prep(make_recipe(train, num_comp = 2)) |> bake(new_data = NULL) |> select(-SalePrice, -Id) nnet_params <- extract_parameter_set_dials(nnet_wf) |> finalize(preds) |> update( hidden_units = hidden_units(range = c(2L, 15L)), num_comp = num_comp(range = c(2L, 15L)) ) set.seed(42) nnet_grid <- grid_space_filling(nnet_params, size = 20) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nnet_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq) set.seed(42) nnet_tuned <- tune_grid( nnet_wf, resamples = folds, grid = nnet_grid, metrics = nnet_metrics, control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE, save_workflow = TRUE) ) saveRDS(nnet_tuned, here("models", "nnet_res.rds")) ``` ::: ### Tuning results ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} autoplot(nnet_tuned, metric = "rmse") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![RMSE across the tuning grid (autoplot).](04-neural-net_files/figure-html/tune-plot-1.png){width=864} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} show_best(nnet_tuned, metric = "rmse", n = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Finalize and fit ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} best_nnet <- select_best(nnet_tuned, metric = "rmse") best_nnet ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} final_nnet_wf <- finalize_workflow(nnet_wf, best_nnet) set.seed(42) nnet_fit <- fit(final_nnet_wf, data = train) ``` ::: ## Cross-validated performance ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} collect_metrics(nnet_tuned) |> semi_join(best_nnet, by = names(best_nnet)) |> select(.metric, mean, std_err, n) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ### Observed vs predicted (out-of-fold) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} collect_predictions(nnet_tuned) |> filter(.config == best_nnet$.config) |> ggplot(aes(x = SalePrice, y = .pred)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = 2) + geom_point(alpha = 0.35, colour = house_pal[3]) + labs(title = "Neural Net — CV predicted vs observed", x = "Observed log(SalePrice)", y = "Predicted log(SalePrice)") + coord_equal() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Out-of-fold predicted vs observed log(SalePrice).](04-neural-net_files/figure-html/obs-pred-1.png){width=528} ::: ::: ## Save the fitted workflow ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} saveRDS(nnet_fit, file = here("models", "nnet_fit.rds")) ``` ::: ## Submission ```bash quarto render docs/submission.qmd -P model:nnet ``` ## Next steps - Continue to the interpretable **[Elastic Net](06-elasticnet.qmd)** linear baseline, then **[SVM](07-svm.qmd)** and **[MARS](08-mars.qmd)**. - Back to the **[master results table](../index.qmd)**.
